steps.name: Alina
steps.text: So? You fought them off, is that it?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I was right not to go with you.  Burning people alive... If I ever have to smell that again, I'm sure I'll throw up.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Alina, don't force yourself.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I'm the one who followed you in the first place.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And I'll protect your Infected here. I will.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: No, I'm not here to beg you to—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Of course you're not. Alina, without you, I wouldn't have the time to go gather resources or info.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Who's your contact? Would it be safe to tell me?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Are you worried I'm an Ursus spy?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Just wondering if it'd be better not to get you wrapped up in this.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: The moment we became Infected, life for us couldn't get any worse.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm in contact with Infected in other places.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Trying to keep tabs on which way the cities are moving, so I can help the Infected surviving out in the Northwestern Tundra as best as I can.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: What you're doing is... insane, in a lot of ways.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Where did your conviction come from? Did someone teach you all this?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What taught me was both malignant and deranged, brimming with the arrogance of rule and the terror of power.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And I vowed to walk against it. I'm going to tear their decorous flesh straight from their bones, pull apart the noble cities their pride built layer by layer, and let everyone know the truth, everyone out on the Tundra...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And after that, we'll decide our own destinies.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We're going to clear this land out. We'll found our own homeland, and if anyone thinks to stop us, we'll topple them right then and there.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Part of this world belonged to the Infected in the first place... just as so many places across this land belong to all people.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: ...Be more realistic, Talulah. This is all too out there.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: If you do this, the village will be destroyed. They'll have nowhere to go, and the Patrol Unit will chase them down.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And if I don't do this, the village would still end up abandoned over time.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Not everyone can join the army. The elderly, children, the injured and sick. If you have them give up everything they've ever survived on, they'll die no matter the soil quality.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I know, Alina. So we'll find somewhere new.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Come on. Let's go. We've got somewhere we can stay tonight.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Thank you for having us.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Ain't nothing. Without you, we'd probably all be dead by now. Though we're still pretty much at death's door.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Sorry. Back at the start, seeing you, I was readying up to fight. That was all my bad.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Don't really have anything left to welcome you with, either. Just put up with this bit of oat gruel, I guess.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: We're extremely thankful, sir. You shouldn't have, honestly.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: No, it's nothing. We only had this bit left over, anyway. However many days we have left, makes no difference.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Wanna set up a village, huh? Doesn't matter how far you go... there's no point. Not much point at all.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: We can't run. You know how big Ursus is? There's no point heading anywhere when there's patrol guys all over... and other people aren't gonna want us. We've got nowhere to go.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Then come with me.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: ...Where? Now?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It doesn't need to be now.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'll wait until you've thought it all through. Or if you end up with absolutely nowhere left to go, and you still want to live on, come find me, or find one of my brothers.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If we head for the wilderness, life in the tundra's... cruel, to say the least.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But we've got places to go. Places without the hearth of civilization as of yet. We'll find somewhere we can sow and harvest; we have so many people, they'd surely be able to help out with business, and we'd have an income.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We can always live on.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: And if the patrolmen come?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: —We'd defeat them.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: ...What did you just say?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What I can do, you can too. You were correct, arming yourself against me back there.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If people think to come and rob us, we'll come together and fight them off. The Infected have strength.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We Infected can, bit by bit, regain our own lives.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Our bread. Our flames.
